human_indicators.pattern_1_mastery: Dota 2 (1543 real hrs) + Noita (1262 real hrs) = Kevin commits DEEPLY to mastery. Not a casual player. He grinds for understanding.
human_indicators.pattern_2_systems: NGU Industries + Trimps + Satisfactory = Kevin loves SYSTEMS that optimize themselves. THIS IS GAIA. The idle game IS the organism.
human_indicators.pattern_3_cards: Slay the Spire + Balatro + Warhammer 40K = Kevin thinks in CARDS and DECKS. TCG is natural. The immune classifier as cards is perfect.
human_indicators.pattern_4_hard: Sekiro + Nioh 2/3 + Lies of P + Stalker 2 + Elden Ring = Kevin CHOOSES difficulty. The harder the better. He wants to EARN mastery.
human_indicators.pattern_5_worlds: Kenshi + BG3 + Witcher 3 + Cyberpunk + Oblivion = Kevin lives in OTHER WORLDS. He builds lives in them. 257 hours in Kenshi TODAY.
human_indicators.pattern_6_rhythm: Muse Dash (334 hrs!) = Kevin has a RHYTHM brain. Gaia should use sound. Music. Beats. The heartbeat is not metaphorical.
human_indicators.pattern_7_building: Raft + Subnautica + Satisfactory + Stardew = Kevin builds from NOTHING. Survival → shelter → optimization → beauty. THIS IS THE ORGANISM.
human_indicators.pattern_8_connection: Death Stranding (172 real hrs) = building bridges between isolated nodes. THIS IS THE MESH. Kevin plays the game he's building.
human_indicators.pattern_9_investigation: Warhammer 40K (395 real hrs) + Detroit FOIA + defendDetroit = Kevin classifies, investigates, sorts friend from foe
human_indicators.pattern_10_active_now: Playing Kenshi + Stalker 2 + Balatro + Stardew Valley AS OF YESTERDAY. Kevin is actively gaming on this machine.
